stances.summary: Both administrations achieved more drug cost progress than predecessors
stances.quote: Claims about what the Trump administration has accomplished on drug prices are somewhat exaggerated. But, there has been more progress on drug costs under the Biden and Trump administrations than was ever made before.

stances.summary: Insurance denials often overturned on appeal, but few patients appeal
stances.quote: New: When patients appeal prior authorization denials by health insurance companies, the denials often get overturned. The problem is, few people appeal.

stances.summary: Presents both Medicare for All benefits and criticisms as equally valid
stances.quote:
Medicare for All advocates talk about universal coverage, no premiums and out-of-pocket costs, administrative savings, and eliminating insurance profits.

Opponents talk about higher taxes, more government control, and giving up your current insurance plan.

All of that is true.

stances.summary: Questions feasibility of work requirements for vulnerable Medicaid enrollees
stances.quote: Will a Medicaid enrollee who suffers from seizures and addiction, and became homeless after losing his job, be able to navigate the process to prove he's too frail to work? That's the kind of question hanging over the implementation of a new Medicaid work requirement. @K_Hought

stances.summary: Argues Medicare for All has simpler messaging than incremental reforms
stances.quote: Medicare for All is the only health reform policy that truly fits on a bumper sticker. Incremental policies are inherently more complicated to explain. The ACA did much more than ban pre-existing condition exclusions, but that part was easy for people to grasp.

stances.summary: Highlights perverse incentive in healthcare job growth funding
stances.quote: This isn't a great dynamic, obviously for people looking for work, but also because someone has to pay for the health care spending generated by more health care jobs.

stances.summary: Surprise billing fixed for patients, provider reimbursement process remains problematic
stances.quote: Surprise medical billing was largely fixed for patients. But, the process for resolving how much out-of-network providers should get paid by insurers is objectively quite a mess.

stances.quote:

stances.summary: State subsidies preserve ACA enrollment; federal cuts cause drops elsewhere
stances.quote: ACA enrollment has dropped in every state, except New Mexico. What's special about New Mexico? They are the only state to fully replace the extra federal premium subsidies that ended this year.

stances.summary: Highlights policy changes increasing uninsured rate above 10%
stances.quote: New: With enhanced ACA premium subsidies expired and Medicaid cuts phasing in, the Congressional Budget Office expects the share of the population uninsured to rise above 10% for the first time since the ACA was implemented.

stances.summary: Signals Medicare for All will become prominent campaign issue if El-Sayed wins
stances.quote: If Abdul El-Sayed wins the Michigan senate primary next week, I suspect we're going to be talking a lot more about Medicare for All.
